title: Where the Windows package stands
caption: WESP is a private preview. Native Sysmon is Insiders only and off by default. Memory integrity is a staged default from October 2026. Quick Machine Recovery ships, and it recovers boots.
alt: Status board: WESP in private preview, native Sysmon on Insiders and off by default, memory integrity a staged default from October 2026, Quick Machine Recovery shipping but only recovering boots.
